text:
Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan, with only a couple of big sights each day so your parents aren't rushed:

Day 1, Forts and palaces: Amber Fort early, before the crowds and heat. Take a short photo stop at Jal Mahal on the way back. After lunch, see the City Palace and Jantar Mantar, then rest at the hotel.
Day 2, Old city: Hawa Mahal in the morning light, then Albert Hall Museum. Have a long lunch, then browse Johari Bazaar or Bapu Bazaar for jewellery, textiles and sweets. End with dinner and a folk show at Chokhi Dhani.
Day 3, Temples and views: Govind Devji Temple for the morning aarti, then Birla Temple. Visit Nahargarh Fort for the sunset view, then head to the station or airport.

Late October is pleasant in Jaipur, so mornings and evenings are the best time for walking. Hire a car with a driver for all three days, as Amber and Nahargarh have steep approaches and many steps.

Which dates are they travelling, and do they have any trouble with stairs? I can then adjust the pace.
